Margin is a share of the invoice, not a mark-up on cost, so the fixed fee is grossed up to hit it — 22.5% margin needs a 29.0% uplift, and the floor holds at 22.5%. Pass-through and tech bill at cost: no margin, no discount, and excluded from revenue.
